subject: [PATCH v3 09/12] nfsd: grant a plain read delegation when timestamps are wanted on a read open

2026-11-24.patch_summary: This patch modifies the NFS server's delegation handling to grant a plain read delegation when a client requests delegated timestamps on a read open operation. This is done by declining the attribute delegation request, as per RFC 9754 section 5, and instead granting a standard read delegation. The patch addresses an issue where delegating atime correctly would require exclusive authority over it or merging the times of multiple read holders, which NFSD does not support.
